# NEEC: Normative Economic Evaluation Criteria

> NEEC compares economic systems on one fixed set of normative criteria: 26 criteria in five domains (Material Security, Human Autonomy, System Resilience, Ethical Integrity, Implementation Viability). Each criterion is scored 0, 0.5 or 1; a 0 is a structural failure, and a system's adequacy tier depends only on its number of structural failures (0-2 Potentially Adequate, 3-5 Partially Adequate, 6 or more Structurally Inadequate), not on its total. Version 2.0 is in preparation in this repository; version 1 (12 systems, 25 criteria) is published at https://sites.google.com/view/normativeeconomicevaluation/home. Authors: Duke Johnson and Claude (Anthropic). Duke Johnson designed CCO-PTF-CIP-SZH, one of the scored systems; README.md states this disclosure and how the project handles it. License: CC BY 4.0.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/README.md): status, current scores, disclosure, how to reproduce every result
- [Scores (CSV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/neec_scores.csv): one row per system: domain scores, total out of 26, structural failures, adequacy tier
- [Data dictionary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/neec_scores_data_dictionary.md): the CSV's fields
- [Score vectors (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/neec_corpus.json): every system's 26 criterion scores
- [Criteria (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/criteria.json): the 26 criteria and their scoring anchors
- [Scoring protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/SCORING_PROTOCOL.md): how each criterion is scored and what a scoring document must contain
